# Copilot Instructions

- Work in small, verifiable increments.
- Inspect the repository before changing anything.
- Do not rewrite or delete existing code without a clear reason.
- If a decision is ambiguous, choose the safest reasonable default, document it, and continue.
- Stop only when continuing could create a security, privacy, data-loss, or architectural problem.
- Keep the project buildable at every stage.
- Do not claim a feature works unless it has been tested.
- Use typed, validated application APIs for all mutations.
- Protect sensitive patient data; do not log DOB, full postcode, access tokens, raw secrets, or unnecessary health information.
- Preserve audit history and avoid physical deletes for appointment state.
